title: A tag was pushed, but no GitHub Release was ever published for it
author: kothar-wa-khasis
description: Matches the repository's own pushed git tags against its GitHub Releases by exact tag_name, and surfaces a tag with no matching release as the seam gap. Pushing a tag and publishing a release are independent GitHub actions -- nothing in the API or UI ever flags a tag that never became a release.
confidence_notes: Age-gated on how long the tag has sat unreleased, mirroring duplicate-milestone-still-open's own 24h bar rather than inventing a new number for a structurally similar 'no prose marker' seam. Under 24 hours since the tag was pushed scores 0.5 (below the 0.70 bar, weighed in the tail not hidden -- a human may be mid-release, about to publish within the day). At or past 24 hours it scores a flat 0.85 -- an unambiguous, non-fuzzy signal, exact tag_name match found nowhere in the release list. A tag with a matching release is excluded at confidence 0.0, named not hidden, the identical discipline every recipe before this one holds.
